stories.title: Trump dismisses tech CEO calls for AI regulation and slower development
new_facts: Daily Mail columnist Sarah Vine likens the AI race to WWII atomic bomb development, says no 'grown ups' will stop it.
AI infrastructure stocks slumped while cybersecurity shares rose after Amodei's slowdown call.
Altman describes AI development as 'walking a narrow middle path' amid Trump's risk denial.
Trump mocks Amodei on Truth Social, calling him 'pretending to be a perfect little angel.'
Trump calls AI slowdown efforts a 'sick conspiracy' that only benefits China.
Financial expert Bill Cohen calls the CEOs' AI warnings a 'wake-up call' to take seriously.
Elon Musk is reported to agree with Amodei's call for an AI slowdown.
Anthropic is meeting prospective investors ahead of a potentially historic IPO even as Amodei pushes for a slowdown.
China rejects AI 'threat narratives' and calls for international cooperation on AI.
Report says Amodei urges restricting China's access to AI tech, prompting accusations of a US dominance strategy.
Microsoft sets limits for future AI models, joining Anthropic and OpenAI in throttling frontier development.
stories.line: Tech CEOs call for AI regulation and slower development; Trump dismisses the warnings and opposes new rules.

stories.title: Saudi pipeline closure sends oil above $109 as Middle East tensions escalate
new_facts: MBS met U.S. commander, requested more U.S. military help against Houthi offensive
US 10-year Treasury yield hit 5% amid oil-driven bond sell-off
Saudi Arabia blames Iranian-backed militias in Iraq for the pipeline attack
Trump will consider declassifying 9/11 records on alleged Saudi role, per family requests
Houthis captured two strategic Red Sea islands, tightening grip on shipping route
Pipeline shutdown now said to affect up to 5% of global oil supply, not 4%
Saudi Arabia in 'strategic shock' after failing to secure more U.S. military backing
Diesel prices hit a new all-time high amid pipeline shutdown and oil price jump
stories.line: Saudi pipeline closure and Middle East tensions push crude above $109, raising U.S. gas prices and borrowing costs.

stories.title: Apple rolls out iOS 27 with upgraded AI Siri across devices
new_facts: Review finds Siri AI impressive but sometimes misunderstands or hallucinates.
Apple rolls out iOS 27, watchOS 27, iPadOS 27, visionOS 27, and macOS 27 Golden Gate, all featuring new Siri AI.
macOS 27 Golden Gate only supports Apple Silicon Macs, ending Intel Mac support after macOS Tahoe.
stories.line: Apple releases iOS 27 and related OS updates with new AI-powered Siri; reviewers note impressive moments but occasional errors.

stories.title: Palestinian activist sues Columbia for failing to stop campus harassment
new_facts: Khalil sues Columbia; detained 104 days, missed child's birth, released by federal judge order
Lawsuit alleges Columbia failed to protect Khalil and other pro-Palestinian campus group members from harassment
Lawsuit uses specific legal standard 'deliberate indifference' to describe Columbia's alleged failure
Suit says indifference predated the 2023 Hamas attacks; other former student activists join as plaintiffs
stories.line: A Palestinian activist is suing Columbia University, alleging the school ignored harassment of pro-Palestinian students on campus.

stories.title: Trump claims Russia-Ukraine energy truce; Ukraine says it's open to talks
new_facts: Trump publicly blames rising diesel prices mainly on the Russia-Ukraine war, not Iran.
ISW assesses Russia has made near-zero net battlefield gains since March.
Trump claims Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy-infrastructure truce.
Zelenskyy says Ukraine is open to halting strikes on Russian energy if Russia reciprocates.
New US-mediated Ukraine-Russia talks expected to begin in October.
Both sides are developing fully autonomous AI attack drones.
Polish FM Sikorski warns NATO would defeat Russia quickly if attacked.
stories.line: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agreed to halt energy attacks; Ukraine says it's open to talks; unclear if any deal exists.

stories.title: Premier League stands down VAR officials after Manchester derby offside error
new_facts: VAR officials stood down and likely blocked from future Man Utd matches for 'error of judgement'
Names the VAR officials: Matt Donohue and assistant Blake Antrobus, not appointed this weekend
Names Howard Webb as the chief refereeing officer who made the stand-down decision with his team
stories.line: Premier League referees who missed an offside call in a Manchester derby will not officiate Manchester United matches going forward.

stories.title: DHS watchdog documents immigrants caged in phone-booth-sized enclosures at Florida ICE facility
new_facts: DHS watchdog report reveals detainees at Alligator Alcatraz held in phone-booth-size outdoor cages, deemed inhumane
Investigators found facility violated standards for hygiene, medical care, food and safety beyond cage use
Facility staff referred to the small cages as 'calming areas'
Report specifies 79 detainees held in four-foot-wide 'calming area' enclosures between July 2025 and January
Some detainees were confined in the outdoor cages for more than an hour at a time
stories.line: DHS watchdog report documents immigrants held in phone-booth-sized outdoor cages at a Florida ICE facility called Alligator Alcatraz.

stories.title: Man admits 20-year campaign of drugging and raping wife; 13 others charged in case
new_facts: New story: husband admits 60 charges of drugging/raping wife over 20 years; 13 other men also charged.
Names court: Manchester Minshull Street Crown Court, where guilty pleas were entered.
Specifies offence types: rape and administering a substance with intent among the 60+ charges.
Reveals accused's age (60s) and residence (Stockport, Greater Manchester).
stories.line: A British man pleaded guilty to drugging and raping his wife repeatedly over 20 years; at least 13 other men face separate charges involving the same victim.

stories.title: Trump rejects AI regulation as industry flags risks
new_facts: Trump publicly rejected AI regulation calls and directly criticized Anthropic's Amodei
JD Vance joined Trump in dismissing AI guardrail calls; over 1,000 AI employees petitioned for oversight
Trump called AI safety critics 'negative forces'; Altman confirmed OpenAI will not IPO this year citing safety
Altman detailed two specific ways he believes AI could go 'very badly'
stories.line: Trump opposes AI regulation; industry leaders describe risks including misuse and uncontrolled development.
